scope: Graphics binding proposals, not existing runtime API or gameplay decisions

bindings.rule: Display ownership from authoritative profile; does not imply equipped.
Show on actual worn item; use the same appearance in gallery and battle.
Selection is local presentation; compatibility and effect values come from runtime data.
Do not equip on an incompatible hero.
Await authoritative operation result; graphics do not spend currency.
Specific missing component icons come from R3; show actual recipe requirements as runtime text.
Show failure state; never display success before acknowledgement.
Playback is visual only; map phase progress to four frames, duration controlled by runtime.
Quantity is dynamic text. Availability and state reflect gameplay data; icons do not enforce duration or power.
Generic activation accent for both consumables; actual acknowledgement is supplied by runtime.
Display only while runtime reports this proposed effect. No numeric slowdown or duration is baked in.
Display only while runtime reports this proposed effect. No reward multiplier is baked in.
Visual expiration, without resurrection, invulnerability or healing.
Visual contact cue only. Boss still requires at least three independent hits; not an extra hit or instant kill.
Trail follows the actual return path. Rendering does not add damage or a second hit.

exclusions: Debt clock passive production bonus is R5; no production graphic or activation binding here.
Models, rigging, model animation clips, audio and code integration are outside this pack.
No health, resurrection, invulnerability, automatic kill or altered boss hit count.
